about: Our Launchroom pipeline: Numbers-First Reverse Engineering (#/find) using the 200-Keyword Q4 Bible & Multi-Video US Viral Density (>=5 videos across >=3 US creators), 5-Point Hard Verification (#/verify -> #/winners), 2-Kit Only + $4.99 Shipping Protection Storefront (#/build), 20 4:5 Static Ads (10 Problem-Aware + 10 Solution-Aware via winning-statics & sbc-statics-2.0) + Top 1-3 Viral Video Ads (#/create), 7-Point Launch Checklist (#/checklist), Meta Campaign Launch (#/launch), and Manage (#/manage: 4-Day Algorithm Priming, End-of-Day 3 Kill Gate & Day 4+ Veo Scale).

steps.name: Product
steps.purpose: Brute-force reverse-engineer where the sales numbers are hitting on Kalodata US (>=5 viral videos across >=3 US creators), that we can dropship, tied to our issues (#/find).
steps.startWhen: A round takes a focus from our 200-keyword Q4 macro-trend pillars.
steps.doneWhen: Candidates pass intake filters and the hard test starts on Verify (#/verify).
steps.ownerPart: Nothing here: agents scrape and filter; you decide on Winners (#/winners).
steps.stopIf: Passive marketplace item (<5 US viral videos), commodity slop, or <$24 retail floor.

prompts.label: Run Numbers-First Kalodata US wave
prompts.text: Scout [category] using our 200-Keyword Q4 Bible on Kalodata US (country: US, pageSize: 100): require >=5 active US viral videos across >=3 US creators, download .mp4 videos, and stage into Verify.

prompts.label: Audit a video from Drive
prompts.text: Check this video from my Drive: [file or link]. Pull Kalodata US sales and active creator count, verify HyperSKU/CJ landed cost, and stage into Verify.

prompts.label: Filter out commodities
prompts.text: Find unique problem-solving mechanisms in [niche] with rising 30d US velocity and >=5 viral videos, skipping brick-and-mortar commodities.

steps.name: Buyers
steps.purpose: For a product you saved or staged into Verify, mine 4-5 star Amazon reviews FIRST (3 best features), 15+ quotes, and 3+ avatars.
steps.startWhen: You pressed Save or the candidate entered Verify (#/verify).
steps.doneWhen: A1-A3 pass: 15+ verbatim quotes, 3+ avatars, and 3 best review features are saved.
steps.ownerPart: Nothing to click here; buyer avatars and quotes feed Winners and ad copy.
steps.stopIf: Buyers report severe product defects or high return rates in 2-4 star reviews.

prompts.label: Mine 4-5 star Amazon reviews
prompts.text: Research buyers for [product] ([L###]): mine 4-5 star Amazon reviews first for the top 3 features, then 2-4 star objections and 15+ quotes.

prompts.label: Extract avatar hooks
prompts.text: Pull 15+ verbatim buyer quotes for [product] sorted into trigger moment, relief, objections, and headline hooks.

prompts.label: Cross-check forum demand
prompts.text: Check Reddit and YouTube comments for [product] to validate real-world buying intent.

steps.name: Prove it
steps.purpose: Verify room on Meta (0-15 ads), exact 1-piece SKU on HyperSKU/CJ (<35% landed cost), and the 2-Kit money line (>= $22-$30 CPA floor) in #/verify.
steps.startWhen: Runs automatically in Verify (#/verify) before a card enters Winners.
steps.doneWhen: P1-P5 pass with zero evidenceFlags so the verified winner lands on Winners (#/winners).
steps.ownerPart: Look at Winners (#/winners) and click Build this one or Reject.
steps.stopIf: Meta is saturated (20+ advertisers), item is a custom DTC brand, or air-landed cost exceeds 35%.

prompts.label: Run 5-point hard verification
prompts.text: Verify [L###]: check US Meta Ad Library competition, verify exact 1-piece SKU & <35% air-landed cost on HyperSKU/CJ first, and calculate 2-Kit KPIs.

prompts.label: Calculate 2-Kit unit economics
prompts.text: Work out 1-Kit (+ $7.99 shipping) and 2-Kit (Save 15% + Free Shipping) + $4.99 Shipping Protection economics for [product].

prompts.label: Check HyperSKU & CJ shipping
prompts.text: Verify exact weight, box dimensions, and US/CA/UK/AU air shipping on HyperSKU and CJ for [product] before asking Amy.

steps.name: Create
steps.purpose: Deconstruct winning viral videos to build 20 4:5 static ads (10 Problem-Aware + 10 Solution-Aware), 5 captions + 5 headlines, and 1-3 viral .mp4 videos (#/create).
steps.startWhen: You clicked Build this one on Winners.
steps.doneWhen: C1-C4 pass: 20 4:5 statics (10 Problem-Aware + 10 Solution-Aware), 5 captions + 5 headlines, and 1-3 viral videos are ready.
steps.ownerPart: Approve the 20 static ads and videos in Creatives (#/create).
steps.stopIf: Statics ignore the viral video, storefront repeats 'You have to get this...', or images use PIL.

prompts.label: Build 20 statics from viral video
prompts.text: Deconstruct the viral video for [product] (3s/7s frames + hook) and build 20 4:5 static ads (10 Problem-Aware + 10 Solution-Aware via winning-statics) + 5 captions & 5 headlines (sbc-statics-2.0).

prompts.label: Write Website vs. Ad Headline Split
prompts.text: Write urgent reveal hooks for Meta Ads and elevated boutique/hardware titles for hero.headline and purchase.heading on [product].

prompts.label: Generate 8K PDP gallery slides
prompts.text: Generate 6-7 8K DSLR-contrast gallery slides for [product] combining real video truth frames with static_01..50.png layouts.

steps.name: Build
steps.purpose: Clone base-theme.json + palette into <slug>.json (#/build) with 2 Kits Only (1-Kit + 2-Kit) + $4.99 protection and verify the 7/7 Checklist (#/checklist).
steps.startWhen: Store copy and gallery images are ready.
steps.doneWhen: B1-B5 and all 7 Checklist items (7/7) pass on localhost:3021 and Shopify Admin.
steps.ownerPart: Preview the live store in Store (#/build) and verify the 7/7 Checklist (#/checklist).
steps.stopIf: Page has a 3-Kit tier, companion add-on bundles, or shares a Meta Pixel across unrelated niches.

prompts.label: Clone base-theme.json & build store
prompts.text: Clone base-theme.json for [product] with 2 Kits Only (1-Kit + $7.99 shipping, 2-Kit Save 15% + Free Shipping) + $4.99 protection and sync Shopify Admin.

prompts.label: Run 7-Point Launch Checklist (7/7)
prompts.text: Verify all 7 Launch Checklist items for [product]: 375px mobile, copy angles, 2-Kit + $4.99 math, QoL, Shopify Admin, category Meta Pixel, and supplier.

prompts.label: Verify category-isolated Meta Pixel
prompts.text: Confirm [product] uses its dedicated category Meta Pixel in Shopify Customer Events with one clean Purchase event.

steps.name: Launch
steps.purpose: Save the test sheet before any spend, set the $50/day CBO budget and CPA guardrails (#/launch), and launch into Manage (#/manage).
steps.startWhen: All 7 Launch Checklist items (7/7) are verified.
steps.doneWhen: L1-L5 pass: campaign is launched and the product moves into Manage (#/manage).
steps.ownerPart: Confirm the $50/day budget and click Launch in #/launch.
steps.stopIf: Duplicate Purchase pixel firing or missing tier-1 market.

prompts.label: Prepare $50/day CBO launch
prompts.text: Stage the $50/day broad CBO across US, CA, UK, AU for [product] with Break-Even and Target CPA guardrails.

prompts.label: Verify pixel & checkout
prompts.text: Verify /products/[handle] checkout and confirm one clean Meta Purchase event before launching.

prompts.label: Move launched product to Manage
prompts.text: Mark [product] launched and sync live Meta & Shopify metrics into Manage (#/manage).

steps.name: Learn
steps.purpose: Manage launched products in #/manage (Day 1-2 priming, End-of-Day 3 kill, fix or scale, and Day 4+ Veo AI videos).
steps.startWhen: Product is launched and live in Manage (#/manage).
steps.doneWhen: R1-R3 pass: scaled on Day 4+ with Veo videos or cut via Cancel & Wipe at End of Day 3.
steps.ownerPart: Review Daily Numbers, Ad Testing, Store & CRO, and Scale or Cut in #/manage.
steps.stopIf: Never cut at the start of the day; wait until the END of Day 3.

prompts.label: Sync & audit Daily Numbers
prompts.text: Sync live Meta & Shopify numbers for [product] in #/manage and compare Day 1, Day 2, and Day 3 against our CPA, CTR, and ATC baselines.

prompts.label: Run Store & CRO bottleneck fix
prompts.text: Diagnose the Click -> ATC -> Checkout -> Order bottleneck for [product] in #/manage?tab=store and propose a post-launch CRO tweak.

prompts.label: End-of-Day 3 Scale or Cut / Day 4 Veo
prompts.text: Evaluate [product] at the end of Day 3: recommend either Cancel & Wipe Product or Day 4 custom Veo AI video ads + CBO scaling.

anytime.label: What's on the pipeline?
anytime.text: What's on the pipeline and what's next for [product]? Tell me its step, whether its gate passed, and what needs my decision.

anytime.label: Sync Live Meta & Shopify Now
anytime.text: Run a live Meta and Shopify sync right now and show me the reconciled Day-by-Day and Lifetime numbers in Manage.

anytime.label: Run Numbers-First Kalodata US Sweep
anytime.text: Run a Numbers-First Reverse Engineering sweep across our 200-Keyword Q4 Bible on Kalodata US (>=5 active US viral videos across >=3 US creators).

anytime.label: Audit Launchroom Hubs & Docs
anytime.text: Audit our Launchroom Hubs (copy, creatives, winners, research, store, team) and update any outdated rules.

anytime.label: Fix something in Launchroom
anytime.text: Fix [what's wrong] in Launchroom, rebuild os/dist, and verify with os.mjs doctor.

anytime.label: Cancel & Wipe a failed product
anytime.text: Cancel and wipe [product] cleanly so it leaves our active pipeline and resets templates.ts to base-theme.json.
